step: In a mid-credits scene, Magneto, his powers restored, meets Logan at an airport to warn him of a new threat to mutants.
In a mid-credits scene, Deadpool travels back in time and shoots Weapon XI dead.
Rogue hunts Trask for the Genosha attack and lets him fall, and his body rises as a Prime Sentinel until Cable stops it.
Insect-like Brood aliens try to turn captives into hosts for their young, and the X-Men fight them.

entry.k: Callisto's gang of outcast mutants
st: Arclight, Psylocke and Quill join Magneto's Brotherhood and storm the cure lab on Alcatraz.

entry.k: A U.S. Army colonel at the Pentagon
st: Colonel Hendry secretly works for Shaw, until Shaw absorbs a grenade blast and turns it on him.

entry.k: Japan's Minister of Justice, engaged to Mariko
st: Mori admits he plotted with Shingen to have Mariko killed, and Logan throws him out a window.

entry.k: A mutant living on Magneto's Genosha
st: Selene follows Magneto to New York to kill Jean Grey and battles the X-Men.

entry.k: A mutant inmate of the Ice Box
st: Black Tom rides in the prison convoy with Russell and Deadpool, and Cable kills him during his attack.

entry.k: A government agent hunting mutants
st: Henry Peter Gyrich works with Bolivar Trask to round up mutants with the Sentinels.
Hunted by Rogue for his part in the Genosha attack, Gyrich is killed by Bastion.

entry.k: Leader of the Morlocks, mutants living underground
st: Callisto kidnaps Cyclops and Jean for the Morlocks, until Storm beats her in a duel for leadership.

entry.k: Mystique's band of mutant troublemakers
st: Avalanche, Pyro and the Blob back Mystique in her schemes against the X-Men.

entry.k: Sebastian Shaw's secret society of the rich
st: Sebastian Shaw, Donald Pierce and Harry Leland's Inner Circle use Mastermind's illusions to bend Jean Grey to their will.

entry.k: The mad emperor of the Shi'ar
st: Emperor D'Ken hunts for the power of the M'Kraan Crystal and orders the X-Men and the Starjammers killed.
He unleashes the Crystal's power, and the Phoenix traps him inside it.

entry.k: A masked agent of the Shi'ar emperor
st: Erik the Red serves Emperor D'Ken in his hunt for the M'Kraan Crystal.

entry.k: The Shi'ar empire's elite super-powered soldiers
st: Emperor D'Ken sends the Imperial Guard against the X-Men and the Starjammers.

entry.k: A man who turns into a winged reptile
st: In the Savage Land, Sauron battles the X-Men.

entry.k: An armored swordsman in Japan
st: In Japan, the Silver Samurai and his gang terrorize a village, and Wolverine stands against them.

entry.k: A warlord from another world
st: Arkon takes Storm to his world to be his bride, and the X-Men clash with him.

entry.k: A Nazi mastermind in World War II
st: In World War II, the Red Skull clashes with Captain America and Wolverine as they raid a Nazi base to rescue a scientist.

entry.k: A techno-organic hive that absorbs living beings
st: The Phalanx absorbs people and most of the X-Men, until Beast leads a team with Magneto and Mister Sinister against it.

entry.k: A trickster spirit who preys on Storm
st: The Adversary torments a powerless Storm and poisons Forge, until Storm regains her powers and fights it off.

entry.k: A killer with long metal claws
st: Lady Deathstrike joins Wolverine's raid on a Weapon X lab overrun by the Brood, and the team escapes as it explodes.

entry.k: Apocalypse's servant in the far future
st: In 3960, Ozymandias leads Apocalypse's Horsemen against the Summers family, then flees when the X-Men beat them.

entry.k: Ichisumi, a Horseman of Apocalypse in 3960
st: In 3960, Pestilence attacks the Summers family with Apocalypse's Horsemen, and the X-Men beat them back.

entry.k: Jeb Lee, a drumming Horseman of Apocalypse in 3960
st: In 3960, Famine fights the X-Men for Apocalypse, until Storm freezes him with arctic winds.

entry.k: A bloated vampire archivist
st: Blade tortures Pearl with a UV light until he reveals Frost's plan to raise La Magra.

entry.k: A police officer serving the vampires
st: Blade beats information out of Krieger, and Frost kills him for his failure.

entry.k: An elite vampire squad trained to kill Blade
st: Damaskinos's Bloodpack, trained to kill Blade, is forced to hunt the Reapers at his side.
Reapers and sunlight kill the squad one by one, and Nyssa, the last, dies in the sunrise.

entry.k: Damaskinos's human familiar and lawyer
st: Kounen helps Damaskinos hold Blade captive, until Whistler guns him down.

entry.k: A police chief working with the vampires
st: Chief Vreede holds Blade in custody after the vampires frame him for a killing.
Blade forces him to lead the way into the vampires' building, then shoots him.

entry.k: Marcus Van Sciver's vampire enforcer
st: Chase carries out Marcus's schemes and faces Krista in the final showdown.

entry.k: A man acquitted of rape
st: Freed by a jury, Quesada is hunted by Daredevil and dies under a subway train.

entry.k: A towering Hand assassin who shrugs off blows
st: Stone hunts Elektra and Abby for the Hand, and Elektra kills him in the forest.

entry.k: A Hand assassin armed with daggers
st: Kinkou joins the Hand's hunt in the forest, and Abby and Mark kill him with one of his own daggers.

entry.k: Howard Saint's son, buying illegal arms
st: Bobby Saint dies in an FBI arms sting run by undercover agent Frank Castle.

entry.k: A small-time gangster working for the Saints
st: Arrested at the sting, Mickey later becomes Frank's inside man against the Saints.

entry.k: A member of Attilan's Royal Guard
st: Locus joins Auran on Earth to hunt down the royal family for Maximus.
She turns to help Black Bolt and Medusa, then dies of a fatal wound.

entry.k: A gangster tied to Geoffrey Wilder
st: Darius runs crime in Los Angeles until Catherine Wilder shoots him dead.

entry.k: Brigid O'Reilly's violent other half
st: Brigid O'Reilly's dark half splits off as Mayhem and hunts criminals as a lethal vigilante.
